name: Unchained Rogue Bloodhound
body:
The bloodhound tracks down targets and brings them to justice, or at least in for a bounty.

Bloodhound (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, the bloodhound gains Survival as a class skill and adds half their level (minimum 1) to Survival skill checks made to follow tracks and Diplomacy checks to gather information.

This ability replaces trap sense.

Bring ‘em Back Alive (Ex)

It is very important for a bloodhound to be able to cash in on their marks. At 1st level, a bloodhound can choose to do non-lethal damage with any weapon with which they are proficient without penalty. In addition whenever the bloodhound makes a non-lethal sneak attack they roll d8s instead of d6s.

This ability modifies sneak attack and trapfinding.

Swift Tracker (Ex)

At 8th level, a bloodhound can move at their normal speed while using Survival to follow tracks without taking the normal –5 penalty.

They take only a –10 penalty (instead of the normal –20) when moving at up to twice normal speed while tracking.

This ability replaces the rogue talent gained at 8th level.

Track the Unseen (Su)

At 10th level, the bloodhound gains the ability to track a target with Survival even while the target is benefiting from pass without trace or similar magic, though at a -10 penalty.

This ability replaces the rogue talent gained at 10th level.
